workflows.title: Submit an event for organizer review
workflows.description: A valid public submission becomes Pending and visible to an organizer.

scenarios.title: Missing required fields
scenarios.description: Form and API reject input; nothing is stored.
scenarios.precondition: Open a blank public event form.
scenarios.action: Submit with one required field missing.
scenarios.expected: The request is rejected and no proposal or upload is stored.

scenarios.title: Invalid venue combination
scenarios.description: Location type conflicts with venue fields.
scenarios.precondition: Choose a location type with incompatible venue fields.
scenarios.expected: Validation identifies the conflict before persistence.

scenarios.title: Bot verification fails
scenarios.precondition: Prepare a complete proposal with a rejected bot token.
scenarios.expected: The request fails closed and stores nothing.

checkpoints.label: CP 02
checkpoints.title: Create Pending proposal
checkpoints.description: API validation, storage, retries and idempotency.

scenarios.title: Duplicate submission retry
scenarios.description: At most one logical proposal should exist.
scenarios.precondition: A complete submission has reached the persistence boundary.
scenarios.expected: Only one Pending proposal and one upload set exist.

scenarios.title: Invalid cover upload
scenarios.description: No partial upload or proposal remains.
scenarios.precondition: Attach an invalid event cover to a valid proposal.
scenarios.expected: The upload is rejected and no partial proposal remains.

scenarios.title: Storage is unavailable
scenarios.description: Failure leaves no partial event data.
scenarios.expected: The failure is visible and no partial proposal is committed.

checkpoints.label: CP 03
checkpoints.title: Show in organizer queue
checkpoints.description: Authenticated organizers must see the stored Pending proposal.

scenarios.title: Proposal missing from organizer queue
scenarios.description: Persistence passed, but authenticated UI evidence failed.
scenarios.precondition: A Pending proposal exists and an organizer is authenticated.
scenarios.expected: The exact Pending proposal is visible once with current submitted facts.

workflows.title: Review and decide on a Pending event
workflows.description: An authenticated organizer reaches exactly one durable decision outcome.

scenarios.title: Organizer lacks access
scenarios.description: UI and API must deny access without exposing data.
scenarios.precondition: Use an unauthenticated or unauthorized organizer session.
scenarios.expected: Access is denied without leaking proposal facts.

checkpoints.label: CP 02
checkpoints.title: Review event facts
checkpoints.description: The decision workspace must show current proposal data.

scenarios.title: Event facts are stale
scenarios.description: Review must display current proposal data.
scenarios.precondition: A Pending proposal contains recently updated facts.
scenarios.expected: Every decision-relevant fact matches the current proposal.

scenarios.title: Concurrent organizer decisions
scenarios.description: Only the first valid decision commits.
scenarios.precondition: Two organizers open the same Pending proposal.
scenarios.expected: Exactly one durable decision wins and the other receives current state.

scenarios.title: Decision transaction fails
scenarios.description: No event or email is partially created.
scenarios.precondition: Force the decision transaction to fail.
scenarios.expected: No partial event, status, audit or email state is committed.

scenarios.title: Organizer acts on stale state
scenarios.precondition: Another organizer has already decided the proposal.
scenarios.action: Submit a decision from a stale review page.
scenarios.expected: The existing durable outcome is returned without mutation.

scenarios.title: Decline reason is missing
scenarios.description: UI and API reject the decision.
scenarios.precondition: Open a Pending proposal and choose Decline.
scenarios.expected: Validation rejects the decision and the proposal stays Pending.

scenarios.title: Approve event
scenarios.precondition: A valid Pending proposal is ready for approval.
scenarios.expected: One approved event is published and linked to the proposal.

scenarios.title: Approval email fails
scenarios.description: Decision remains durable and email can retry.
scenarios.precondition: The email provider rejects an approval notification.
scenarios.expected: Approval commits once and the email remains safely retryable.

scenarios.title: Decline event
scenarios.description: Keep the event private and record the reason.
scenarios.precondition: A valid Pending proposal has a decline reason.
scenarios.expected: The proposal is declined once and no public event is created.

scenarios.title: Decline email fails
scenarios.description: Decision remains durable and email can retry.
scenarios.precondition: The email provider rejects a decline notification.
scenarios.expected: Decline commits once and the reason email remains retryable.
